title: Sentinel — Ingest Observability
description: P1-11 AC1/AC2/AC5: per-tenant/connector ingest lag, EPS, batch size and error rate, fed by go/sentinelconnector's Scheduler via otel-collector. connector_cycle_count_total's outcome label already carries error rate (rate(outcome!="success") / rate(total)), so no separate error-rate metric exists — this dashboard queries the same counter P1-01 introduced. Metric names verified live against the running collector (P1-11's own integration test), not assumed from the OTel spec.

panels.title: Top 20 most-lagging tenants
panels.description: AC5: topk(20, max by (tenant_id) (connector_ingest_lag_seconds)) — the dashboard panel this ticket's acceptance criteria literally names.

panels.title: EPS per connector
panels.description: AC2: rate(connector_events_published_total[5m]) by connector — events per second actually published, not just fetched.

panels.title: Batch size per cycle (p50 / p95)
panels.description: AC2: histogram_quantile over connector_batch_size — events fetched per cycle, before any downstream filtering.

panels.title: Cycle error rate by outcome
panels.description: AC2's error rate: rate(connector_cycle_count_total{outcome!="success"}[5m]) by outcome and connector — reuses P1-01's existing counter rather than adding a redundant one.
